sn22.32:1.1: Tatra || voca || || Pabhaṅguṃ ca bhikkhave desissāmi apabhaṅguṃ ca || || Taṃ suṇātha || || Kiñca bhikkhave pabhaṅgu kiñca apabhaṅgu || || Rūpam bhikkhave pabhaṅgu || yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo idam apabhaṅgu || || Vedanā pabhaṅgu || yo tassā nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo idam apabhaṅgu || || Saññā pabhaṅgu || || Saṅkhārā pabhaṅgu || yo tesaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo idam apabhaṅgu || || Viññāṇam pabhaṅgu || yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo idam apabhaṅgūti || || Bhāravaggo tatiyo || ||
sn22.32:2.0: Tatruddānaṃ || || Bhāram Pariññaṃ Parijānaṃ || Chandarāgaṃ ca catutthakam || Assādā ca tayo vuttā || Abhinandanam aṭṭhamam || Uppādam Aghamūlañ ca || Ekādasamo Pabhaṅgūti || ||
